build.name: ./configure && make (builds PROVER/eprover)
build.cmd: ./configure >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -s 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; B=$(find . -name eprover -type f -perm -u+x | head -1); echo BIN=$B; test -n "$B"

runs.name: prove a group-theory theorem (GRP: shipped TPTP, Unsatisfiable = theorem)
runs.cmd: B=$(find . -name eprover -type f -perm -u+x | head -1); $B --auto --tptp3-format EXAMPLE_PROBLEMS/TPTP/GRP237-1.p 2>&1 | grep -E 'SZS status|Proof found|processed clauses|generated clauses' | head -6

runs.name: prove a Boolean-algebra lemma (BOO006-1, Unsatisfiable)
runs.cmd: B=$(find . -name eprover -type f -perm -u+x | head -1); $B --auto --tptp3-format EXAMPLE_PROBLEMS/TPTP/BOO006-1.p 2>&1 | grep -E 'SZS status|Proof found' | head -3

runs.name: the search cost (generated vs processed clauses) -- the saturation working
runs.cmd: B=$(find . -name eprover -type f -perm -u+x | head -1); $B --auto -s EXAMPLE_PROBLEMS/TPTP/GRP237-1.p 2>&1 | grep -iE 'clauses|generated|processed' | head -6; true

notes: Oracle: the shipped TPTP problems carry '% Status : Unsatisfiable' -- a refutation exists, i.e. the conjecture is a theorem; E must report SZS status Unsatisfiable/Theorem. The problems are E's own EXAMPLE_PROBLEMS/TPTP. Saturation is visible in the generated/processed clause counts.
